intro: Each of the four acceptance criteria has one proof, in the lowest layer that proves it.
worthALook: The expiry is proved with a frozen clock, not by waiting.
latitude: The fixtures and the order the tests run in.

proofs.proves: a valid e-mail returns 201 and one pending invite row
a member's e-mail shows the hint and sends nothing
a valid link adds the member and marks the invite accepted
a link past seven days is refused

convention: The API tests run against a real database in the test stack; the journey runs in the browser. Green means every proof passes.
